newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH AND MONSANTO IN LICENSING DEAL.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH AND MONSANTO IN LICENSING DEAL.

text.p: Research Frontiers Inc said Monday it and the Orcolite division of Monsanto Co have entered an exclusive licensing agreement allowing Orcolite to incorporate Research Frontiers' controllable light transmission technology into a variety of eyewear products.

Under the license agreement, Orcolite will pay Research Frontiers an earned royalty of seven percent of the net selling price of products sold under the agreement, along with minimum royalties which rise over a period of about seven years to $2 million annually if the license is maintained in effect, a news release issued by Research Frontiers said.

In addition to receiving rights to manufacture and sell "smart" eyewear worldwide, Orcolite has the right to sublicense certain related companies and, with Research Frontiers' consent, any third party.
Other terms of the license agreement were not disclosed.
The technology enables consumers to automatically or manually achieve instant and complete control over the degree of light coming through the lenses, the news release said.
The technology can be used in prescription and non-prescription lenses, ski and other sports goggles and sunglasses.
